title: ReleaseBindingIntent
description: agents.mctl.ai/v1alpha2 ReleaseBindingIntent, per ADR 007. This is reviewed intent, not release history: mctl-api's registry remains the sole authority for immutable published versions and atomic environment ReleaseBinding history. A ReleaseBindingIntent pins exactly one compatible (definition, profile) pair plus the sourceManifest that grounds the canonical AgentDefinition. Every fixture checked in under this schema before real registry-backed versions exist must be marked bindingSource: compatibility-fixture and promotable: false so it can never be read as production activation state.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the AgentDefinition file at `path`, as committed. This PINS the definition half of the binding: mctl-agents' resolver recomputes it on every resolution and fails closed when the file has drifted out from under this binding. Without it the definition floats -- the profile half is pinned by profile.version, but agent.yaml could be edited and resolved silently, which is not an atomic binding. Distinct from gitSha, which names a commit nothing can verify from inside a container with no .git.

bindingSource.description: compatibility-fixture = checked-in test/shadow fixture (this issue). registry = resolved from a real mctl-api published version (future work, #227/runtime resolver).

promotable.description: Must be false for any bindingSource: compatibility-fixture. Only a bindingSource: registry intent, resolved from real immutable versions, may ever be true -- and even then this file is reviewed intent, not the promotion action itself.

profileCompatibility.description: The canonical AgentDefinition's executionProfileRef.compatibility constraint, mirrored here because mctl-gitops CI cannot read the mctl-agents source file at sourceManifest.path directly. Checked against profile.version -- compatibility is never read from the profile side.

history.description: Deterministic local fixture of prior binding revisions for this (agent, environment), used only to validate exact-pair rollback semantics before a real mctl-api registry exists. Not itself a release-history store -- see requirements.md's 'must not create a second AgentDefinition body or release database.'

rollbackOf.description: Set only when this intent represents a rollback. Must equal previousBindingRevision, and this intent's (definition, profile) pair must exactly match the history entry recorded under that revision -- an independently chosen or synthetic mix of the two halves is rejected.
